stem.en: Which sentence writes the unit of force correctly?

text.en: A force of 15 Newton (symbol n) acts on the box.

feedback.en: The unit is written with a small n in words, and its symbol is a capital N.

text.en: A force of 15 newton (symbol n) acts on the box.

feedback.en: The word is right, but the symbol is a capital N.

text.en: A force of 15 newtons (symbol N) acts on the box.

feedback.en: Right. The word is written with a small n, and the symbol is a capital N.

explanation.en: The SI unit of force is the newton. In words it is written with a small n; its symbol is a capital N.

hints.en: Look at both the word and the symbol.
